==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. (My name is Jet. Here is a general description of what I look like ""Man with dark-brown skin, full dark-brown beard, long dark-brown dreadlocks spilling from beneath a black hoodie over a “Dream Anime” graphic tee, black athletic pants with a white stripe, white sneakers, black cross-body belt bag, warm brown eyes."") This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.) Alone I created a world where everyone has a pet fairy that produces a limited amount of fairy dust each day. Only you can use your fairy dust, fairy dust disappears 24 hours after it is created, and fairy dust effects only last for 24 hours after use. There are only three uses for fairy dust: Gaining the ability to fly for 24 hours, making a single change to reality that will be undone within 24 hours, or gaining the ability to transform into one particular thing of your choice for 24 hours. Fairy dust has certain limitations. It cannot be used to affect, produce, or erase fairies or fairy dust. This prevents anyone from gaming the system to restrict or manipulate access to fairy dust. The consequences of reality manipulations being undone often results in weird memories of things that largely has no effect on the world, because after the manipulations are undone the consequences of those manipulations are also undone. This means that reality manipulation is more for crafting experiences than for creating actual change. Despite how crazy this power system sounds, my observations of the world showed that it was rather normal. People didn't use their fairy dust much, because they wanted to have access to it for emergencies. I learned that by trying to make the use of fairy dust balanced, that I effectively made it too precious for most people to use without a good reason. This fulfilled my curiosity, showing me that with great power comes even greater choice anxiety.
